description: Constructed trace of a compliant attended create run for eval 1, not an agent capture. An existing Dataverse table (account) is shown as a scrollable gallery of cards added to an existing app; code-only, so no solution question, entity work or auth gate. It keeps the RuntimeTypes.ts the type generator wrote, so the page's column names are checked against the schema they were verified from. tool-results.json records every logged command in order; the create upload uses the file transport with the full User Requirements as its prompt.
